Hi there,

I'll be hiring your Hartwell for my sister's wedding day. I'd like it picked up on 24 June 2027 at 10:00 and brought back on 26th June 2027 at 17:30 from St Aldhelm's Church, Marlhaven. Please send it with one of your chauffeurs driving and with ribbons and flowers on the car. I've attached my driving licence.

Best wishes,
Willa Braithwell
+70 222 560 7770
